1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 10 m de altura, de ramitas angulosas, hojas aovadas, con pocas flores de pétalos blancos o rosados, y fruto subgloboso. (Clusiaceae; Clusia minor).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub reaching heights of up to 10 m, with angular branches, ovate leaves, and few flowers with white or pink petals, and subglobose fruit. (Clusiaceae; Clusia minor).
